summary: Viking Acquisition Corp. II, a Cayman blank-check company listed on the NYSE, filed an 8-K reporting an amended and restated convertible unsecured promissory note issued to Viking Acquisition Sponsor II, LLC. The sponsor advanced an additional $30,000 on September 18, 2026, lifting the principal to $544,080.00 from the prior $514,080.00 note. The non-interest-bearing note matures upon consummation of the initial business combination or the effective winding-up of the company, and converts at the sponsor's election at $10.00 per unit into private-placement-equivalent units. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The incremental loan extends the sponsor's working-capital backstop and increases private-placement overhang. Watch dilution and whether a business combination is announced before the trust deadline.
